title: Renewals Desk Rulebook: Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Elections
content:
Renewals desk rulebook, Residential Electricity Supply. A renewal continues an agreement into a new fixed term by acceptance of the renewal offer stated in the governing renewal notice.

## Rules in force

1. **Active agreements only.** A renewal is accepted only on an active agreement, as shown by the agreement's status.
2. **Start of the new term.** When the election is made on or before the contract end date, the new term starts the day after the contract end date; when it is made after a rollover, the new term starts on the election date. The start date of the new term is recorded on the agreement as its latest renewal or plan change date.
3. **End of the new term.** The new contract end date is counted from the start of the new term in the same way as at activation: the day before the same calendar day, term-months calendar months later, using the last day of the month when that day does not exist.
4. **Post-expiry grace.** When the agreement has already rolled over, a renewal election is honoured only when the customer elects to renew no later than the post-expiry renewal grace period, in calendar days, after the rollover took effect on the plan change date. Day one is the calendar day after the plan change date, and the grace period closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the plan change date plus the grace days; the last day is inside the period.
5. **Late elections.** A late election is not a renewal; the customer may instead change plans under the plan change terms at the then-valid price offer.
6. **Different plan.** Accepting a different plan than the one offered is a plan change, not a renewal.

## Retired clauses

The following two clauses are **no longer in force** and are not applied:

- "A customer renews by accepting the offer stated in the governing renewal notice: the agreement takes the offered plan, its term in months, and the offered renewal rate." This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for the rate at which a renewal is accepted.
- "Each renewal earns one renewal loyalty credit equal to the renewal loyalty credit of the plan renewed into, posted on the first bill of the new term; plans with 0.00 earn none." This clause is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current Residential Electricity Supply basis for renewal loyalty credits.

## Grace-period boundaries (hypothetical dates, using the 30-day grace every plan carries)

| Rollover plan change date | Election date | Day of grace | Honoured as a renewal | New term starts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-01 | 2026-05-31 | day 30, the last day | yes | 2026-05-31 |
| 2026-05-01 | 2026-06-01 | day 31 | no; a plan change may be offered instead | not a renewal |
| no rollover; contract end 2026-04-30 | 2026-04-12 | before expiry | yes | 2026-05-01 |

Each renewal earns one renewal_loyalty_credit equal to the renewal_loyalty_credit_usd of the plan renewed into, posted on the first bill of the new term; plans with 0.00 earn none.
